item.title: Reconnaissance Fundamentals
item.description:
Recon is the part everyone skips and the part that decides whether the rest of the engagement goes anywhere.

Passive vs active

Passive recon touches nothing — DNS records, WHOIS, cached pages, job postings, leaked repos. Active recon touches the target directly: port scans, banner grabs, directory brute-forcing.

Start passive. You’d be surprised how much shows up before you send a single packet.

A simple workflow

  1. Map the domain and subdomains
  2. Identify technologies in use
  3. Look for exposed services and old endpoints
  4. Cross-reference with public breach data and leaked credentials

None of this is exotic. It’s just patient, methodical looking.
